 1          Plaintiff Matthew Dabila (“Plaintiff”) brings this Class Action Complaint on behalf of

 9   personally identifying information, including names, dates of birth, addresses, and Social Security
10   numbers (collectively “PII” or “Private Information”). 1

13   their employers.

18   unauthorized access and disclosure through reasonable and adequate data security measures.

20   Members, their Private Information in Defendant’s possession was compromised when on or about
21   April 2025 through October 15, 2025, Defendant’s “system sent encrypted personal information
